formulas.label: LEFT
formulas.explanation: Extract characters from the beginning of text.

formulas.label: RIGHT
formulas.explanation: Extract characters from the end of text.

formulas.label: MID
formulas.explanation: Extract a section of text using a starting position and character count.

formulas.label: LEN
formulas.explanation: Count characters in text, including spaces.

formulas.label: FIND
formulas.explanation: Find the starting position of text within another text value.

formulas.label: CONTAINS
formulas.explanation: Check whether text occurs in a cell or range and return True or False.

formulas.label: SUBSTITUTE
formulas.explanation: Replace matching text within a text value.

formulas.label: REPLACE
formulas.explanation: Replace text using a starting position and character count.
